title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sun 15 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 14:00. The upslope ran from about 10:30 to about 18:15. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,100 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,500 ft by the Kekoa camera, 400 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,200 ft, off by 300 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 5,200 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 11:37, at Pukalani. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kahikinui stopped at 13:20; the Mesonet could not be reached on 10 of 55 updates.
